steps.description: Ordered interface calls forming a repeated multi-call pattern (REQ-07). These are the requirements for the new API. Each step is an Interface ID (`IFC-(SYNC|ASYNC)-NNNN`) once assigned -- a Stage 1 raw-pass candidate legitimately cannot know that ID yet (assigned downstream by consensus aggregation) and should instead cite the interface by name, method+path, or topic; scripts/consensus.py resolves these name-shaped references once Interfaces are ID-assigned.

frequency.description: For a code-only framing (e.g. by-call-sites) this is a static call-site count, not a runtime invocation count -- do not estimate a traffic-derived number you have no evidence for.
